blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Residents of Tacloban and neighboring municipalities in Leyte will continue to be represented and receive services despite the suspension of Leyte Rep. Ferdinand Martin Romualdez, Tingog Rep. Jude Acidre said on Sunday. In a statement, Acidre sought to quell concerns that the former House speaker’s suspension from service would disrupt constituent services, including hospital, education, and financial assistance. “What matters most is that service to our fellow citizens in Leyte continues uninterrupted,” he said in Filipino. “Assistance to those in need must not be delayed, especially for families dealing with hospital expenses and their children’s education.” He also […]...
